name: Kinetile
summary:
Kinetile is a 3D physics puzzle game about getting one rolling ball to the finish. Drag arrows, jumps, teleports and bouncers into place, then press Start: the board locks and your plan plays out. Watch the ball clear a gap, ricochet into a turn and emerge from a teleport exactly where you planned.

The game has 56 handcrafted levels in two packs. CLASSIC PATHS introduces the tools across 28 levels, from the first turns to routes combining long jumps, teleports and gates controlled by buttons. FORGED PATHS adds 28 puzzles with denser boards, where buttons set sliding platforms in motion and fill gaps in a cascade, so a bridge has to slide into place before the ball arrives.

Infinity mode generates a new puzzle every time on Normal or Hard difficulty. Each board has a seed code that can be copied to replay it or to challenge a friend to solve the same board.

There is no timer or move limit. Stop a run or let the ball fall, and the tiles return to the arrangement you prepared, ready to adjust and try again.
